name: Zero Gravity
tagline: Gravity switches off and everything floats.
subject: the person
motion: Gravity switches off. {subject}'s hair lifts and fans out, loose objects and dust rise slowly into the air around them, and {subject} drifts gently up off the ground, turning slowly with arms floating outward, a look of calm wonder on their face. The camera tilts up to follow. Dreamy soft light.
sound: an airy ambient swell, soft whooshes, and a gentle floating chime
author: Conjure
